paragraphs.en: The first exhibition in a rebuilt local museum attracted much attention, but it also caused turmoil. An eminent historian praised its exquisite objects and fluent written explanations, while residents on the fringe of town complained that their experience was missing. The best known display presented a static picture of prosperous merchants. It said less about the many workers who had supported that wealth. A blunt visitor called the account opaque, although the curators had intended to make history intelligible. The disagreement raised one important question: whose life did a museum preserve when it selected only the most attractive evidence?
paragraphs.zh: 地方博物馆重建后的首次展览引人关注，也引起混乱。著名历史学家赞美精美物件和流畅说明，城郊居民却说自己的经验缺席。最知名陈列静态展示富商，较少讲支持财富的工人。直率访客认为叙述难懂，策展人本想让历史易于理解。分歧提出重要问题：只选最迷人证据，博物馆究竟保留谁的人生？

paragraphs.en: The museum director refused to treat criticism as a petty distraction. She asked each neighborhood to contribute an object and a memory. Some offered used tools with coarse handles; others brought an oval dinner table, an old composite photograph, or a well-known family recipe for a wholesome meal. The objects lacked the glamor of royal jewelry, yet they showed how ordinary households managed work and pleasure. An approximate date was acceptable when no exact record survived. The director wanted more participation, not a competition in which only professional donors felt qualified to share their past.
paragraphs.zh: 馆长不把批评视为琐碎干扰，邀请每个街区提供物件和记忆。有人送粗柄旧工具，有人送椭圆餐桌、老合成照片或知名家庭健康菜谱。它们没有皇家珠宝的魅力，却展示普通家庭如何安排工作与快乐。没确切记录时，近似日期也可。馆长要更多参与，而非只有专业捐赠者有资格分享往昔的竞赛。

paragraphs.en: The process was not unanimous. A stubborn patron wanted to remove every so-called political issue, arguing that the public preferred beauty minus controversy. A resident answered that this was a lame excuse for ignoring difficult evidence. Another worried that overt criticism would make the exhibition worse rather than better. Concurrent discussions therefore explored both the objects and the language used to describe them. A statement about poverty could be accurate without humiliating families, and reciprocal respect did not require agreement about every interpretation. The first useful change was to admit that a museum could tell all visitors something without claiming to tell the whole truth.
paragraphs.zh: 过程并非全体一致。固执赞助人想去掉所有所谓政治议题，称公众要美而不要争议。居民认为这是忽略困难证据的无力借口，也有人怕公开批评让展览更差。因此同时讨论物件和描述语言。关于贫穷的陈述可准确而不羞辱家庭，互相尊重也不必同意每个解释。第一项有效改变，是承认能告诉所有访客某些事情，却不声称拥有全部真相。

paragraphs.en: Curators used up-to-date research to place memories within a wider context. They distinguished a proximate cause of a factory closure from its deeper economic conditions and explained the temporal limits of surviving records. Volatile markets had shaped the town as much as individual ambition. A long oral interview revealed that a ripe apple from a family garden could matter more to a worker than a famous public ceremony. No visitor had to accept every recollection as fact. Any uncertain claim received a clear note, allowing people to appreciate a personal memory while understanding the limits of its evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 策展人用最新研究给记忆更广背景，区分工厂关闭的直接原因与深层经济条件，并说明存留记录的时间限制。不稳定市场与个人雄心同样塑造小镇。长篇口述访谈显示，家园一只熟苹果可能比著名典礼更让工人在意。访客不必把每个回忆当事实，不确定说法都有明确注释，可欣赏个人记忆，也理解证据局限。

paragraphs.en: The renewed exhibition eventually drew a broader audience. School groups discussed why the worst moment in one family's history could coincide with opportunity for another. A once decorative collection had become a place for thinking together. The director remained well aware that there would be disagreements, but she considered the town ripe for this more honest conversation. What mattered most was not whether every visitor left with the same opinion. It was whether the museum helped people recognize unfamiliar experiences and question inherited assumptions without losing the ability to share a room, examine evidence, and listen to one another.
paragraphs.zh: 更新展吸引更广观众。学生讨论为何一家的最糟时刻可能同时是另一家的机会。原本装饰性收藏成了共同思考场所。馆长清楚分歧仍在，但认为小镇已适合更诚实交谈。最重要不是人人离馆时意见相同，而是博物馆能否帮人认识陌生经验、质疑继承的假设，同时仍可共处一室、查看证据并聆听彼此。
